author: Zephyr I
title: FiLM-style late time modulation (both heads) — std-width nodil (BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Replace concat-based late time injection with FiLM-style modulation (learned gamma/beta on 256-d preactivations) for both policy and value heads. Backbone unchanged (d=5 main convs, undilated bottlenecks, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64)). BASE_SEED=42.
